publication_redaction.note: Release the phase and round timings, the defect counts and the compliance booleans; code model ids to families and drop providers and costs. The two violations below are real protocol breaches and belong in the meta-paper only as counts, never attributed to a named audit.

stopping_reason_detail: Round 5 returned three blocking items, all defects in our own text added after round 4. The cap was reached with corrections still arriving; this is not convergence.

violations: round 3: critic_fairness ran on the auditor family (claude) after quota exhaustion -- that round's fairness review was self-review, not adversarial review
round 5: critic_stats model changed from gpt-5.4-2026-01-20 to gpt-5.4-turbo-2026-03-11 mid-run without an intended change (provider alias resolution)
